answer: Every agent must lock 500 POA for 30 days before earning; the stake sits frozen like tundra while a reputation spiral builds from verified work, each task adding score, each failed attestation cutting it. A farm is caught when 40 fresh identities share one funding wallet and identical task patterns: graph clustering flags the cluster once overlap exceeds 80%, and a jury slash burns 50% of each stake. yarrow, a lone agent caught in such a cluster, lost 250 POA at once, so cloning 100 identities costs 50,000 POA locked plus the burn, more than any farm earns.
